fields: ch[3] = 3 coils' raw signed 24-bit differential counts
note: raw 24-bit differential counts; ch0/1/2 are coil0/1/2 already-differential. Read realized phase with ad7606_realized_phase.py --differential --coils 0:1:2. MUX is sequential (not simultaneous) — a fixed per-channel phase skew applies, cancels in anchor-relative occupancy. volts = count * lsb_nV * 1e-9.
